name: TPH Smart Conversion Tracker Lite
author: hasanmatubber15

sections.description:
TPH Smart Conversion Tracker Lite helps you quickly install Facebook Pixel on your WordPress website without coding. It tracks PageView events and helps you build custom audiences for Facebook Ads.

This lightweight plugin is perfect for beginners who want simple and fast pixel integration.

Upgrade to Pro for Advanced Features:

For professional marketers, we recommend:
https://themepluginhub.com/product/smart-conversion-tracker-pro/

Pro Features:
* Facebook Conversion API (CAPI) support
* iOS 14+ tracking fix
* WooCommerce Purchase event tracking
* Server-side tracking for better accuracy
* Priority support and updates

Free Features:
* Easy Facebook Pixel integration
* PageView tracking
* Lightweight and fast performance
* Simple admin panel

For support or custom development:
Telegram: https://t.me/hasanmatubber
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘SCT Free’ and enter your Facebook Pixel ID.
  4. Save settings and start tracking.
sections.faq:
Does it support Conversion API?

No. The free version supports only browser-based tracking. Upgrade to Pro for Conversion API support.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, it works with WooCommerce for basic tracking.
